issues.description: getCategoryLabel heuristics silently change behavior; explicit data table was clearer.
issues.detail: The old code had an explicit map from category id to label, with a deterministic fallback. The new code replaces that with three layered heuristics (special-case dict, version regex, length<=3 means acronym). Data dominates: a flat lookup table is the obvious data structure here. The heuristic ladder will mislabel any new four-letter acronym (e.g. SAML, OIDC, SSRF). Keep the table; use heuristics only as fallback.

issues.description: SEVERITY_ORDER aliases Info and Informational to the same key 4, hiding a data-shape mismatch.
issues.detail: Adding Info: 4 next to Informational: 4 papers over the fact that two producers emit different strings for the same concept. The right fix is upstream: normalize severity at the boundary so the chart code has one canonical shape. Otherwise the next consumer hits the same ambiguity and adds its own alias.

issues.description: HorizontalBarChart recomputes maxValue inside the row loop; data-shape decision belongs outside.
issues.detail: maxValue = Math.max(...data.map(...)) is now evaluated on every iteration of the map. For small n it doesn't matter, but it signals the wrong data shape: max is a property of the dataset, not the row. Compute it once above the map, or have the caller pass normalized percentages. Same data, obvious algorithm.

issues.description: CategorySelector sentinel handling conflates empty string and "all"; one sentinel is enough.
issues.detail: handleValueChange treats both "" and "all" as null. The Select only emits "all" or a real id, so the empty-string branch is dead code. Pick one sentinel ("all") and delete the other. Small, but it's the kind of accidental option that breeds future bugs.

issues.description: Repeated "Threat Score" -> "Prowler ThreatScore" rename should be a single constant.
issues.detail: The same string is rewritten in tooltip, axis name, axis label, header, and details panel. That's a data-structure smell: one product-name string in one place, referenced everywhere. Next rename will miss a site. A tiny constants module would prevent the drift.

issues.description: Removing category__in from DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES while adding CATEGORY filter may drop active-filter badge.
issues.detail: DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES previously had a category__in entry; it's been deleted in the same PR that introduces the Category filter on findings. If the badge list is still the source of truth for the active-filter UI, the new filter will apply but show no badge. Worth confirming the badge is rendered through some other path.

review.summary: The PR ships a useful feature but trades a clear data table (CATEGORY_LABELS map) for a ladder of capitalization heuristics that will misfire on common four-letter acronyms; restoring the table as the primary source and using heuristics only as fallback would make the algorithm self-evident. SEVERITY_ORDER gains a duplicate Info/Informational alias that should be a boundary normalization instead. HorizontalBarChart recomputes max inside the row loop, signaling the wrong place for that data. Smaller nits: dual sentinel handling in CategorySelector, scattered "Prowler ThreatScore" string literal, and a likely-orphaned category badge config. Overall: pick the data structure once, then the algorithms follow.
